entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's try searching the room in the back,[n]Joker!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, that guy looks like bad news.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, he does look pretty tough...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not only that, but it seems like he's more[n]aware of his environment than the others.[n]We'd better proceed with caution.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's just ignore that book for now—[n]it's not the right size for here.
entries.uk: Поки облишмо цю книгу —[n]вона сюди не підходить за розміром.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If only we had another book that[n]fit better...
